title: Professor of Medicine, HMS
bio: Rochelle Walensky, MD, MPH, has served as the 19th Director of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (2021–2023); Professor of Medicine, Harvard Medical School (2012–2021 and 2025-present); and Chief of the Division of Infectious Diseases, Massachusetts General Hospital (2017–2021).
